requests.name: Большая бумажная записка
requests.detail: Subject: exactly one horizontal pale warm butter-yellow rectangular paper note, physical size approximately 21 cm wide by 12 cm tall. A clean calm nearly uniform central area for a future live HTML message. Delicate believable paper grain, slightly irregular natural lower edge but not heavily torn, almost flat with a subtle shallow bend at the bottom. Corners mostly square with tiny natural softness. No curled corner covering the content area, no tape, clips, adhesive strip, folds through the center, lines or printed content. Keep horizontal orientation with only a very slight 1-degree counterclockwise tilt.

requests.detail: Subject: exactly one portrait A5 loose graph-paper sheet, physical size 14.8 by 21 cm, warm off-white matte paper. Fine faint warm-grey square grid, actual square cells corresponding approximately to 5 mm, clean evenly spaced lines of consistent subtle weight across the paper. requests.name: Загнутый уголок страницы
requests.detail: Subject: a reusable isolated realistic folded lower-right page-corner detail, about 5 by 5 cm, made from warm ivory-white matte paper. Show ONLY the folded triangular corner and a very narrow adjoining sliver of the original sheet so it can be composited over the bottom-right corner of a larger HTML page. The crease runs diagonally from upper right to lower left; the small paper flap turns upward/inward toward the upper left, revealing the slightly darker underside. Fine paper fibers and gentle physically believable curvature, not a sharp flat grey triangle. True transparent alpha around the paper shape, including to its left and above. No large rectangular sheet or tabletop surrounding it. No writing, torn edge, binding, shadow halo or extra objects. The lower-right orientation must be immediately usable without mirroring.
